name: Summer at Marisol Bay
source:
Take control of Kyro Ivanovski, the new hire at Marisol Bay Resort. Help him navigate his summer working as the resident entertainer.  

Can Kyro create lasting memories or will he just be another seasonal worker? Will he make new friends? Enemies? Possibly fall in love? 

[From [url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/summer-at-marisol-bay]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将操控马里索尔湾度假村的新员工凯罗·伊万诺夫斯基，帮助他度过担任驻场娱乐人员的这个夏天。

凯罗能创造长久留存的回忆，还是只会成为又一个来去匆匆的季节工？他会交到新朋友，树立敌人，或许还会坠入爱河？

[摘自[url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/summer-at-marisol-bay]itch.io[/url]]
